description: List the authorized clients of a deployment's Tor v3 restricted discovery (client authorization). Returns whether the hidden service is restricted and each authorized client name with its creation date. On a restricted service the .onion stays reachable ONLY by Tor clients presenting an authorized key — this list is who can get in. Requires a deployment with an onion address and an agent supporting onion-auth-v1.

deployment_id.description: The dpl_... id whose onion clients to list.

name: impreza_onion_auth_list
